import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', 
                          size='Daily Steps', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.7, palette='deep')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
